Get 30 days free: http://mubi.com/ducinema Tom Holland. Nowadays everybody knows him as Spider-Man. But becoming Spider-Man has been a gift… and a curse. Because that’s also the only thing that most people know about him. Tom Holland has had a very interesting career, starring in a lot of other movies that most people have never seen. From starting out as a dancer and a gymnast on stage, to playing a war veteran in Cherry and a young redneck in The Devil All the Time. Tom Holland has already shown impressive range, soon he’ll be playing in The Odyssey by Christopher Nolan and perhaps he’ll become the next James Bond. No matter what role he takes on… there’s always this one question hanging over him: Will Tom Holland ever be able to star in a movie where people don’t instantly see Spider-Man? Well, today I wanna shine some light on this young man's career, in order to find out more, about the man behind Spiderman. • Business Inquiries: ducinemaofficial@gmail.com • The rights for all the songs in this video are purchased through Artlist: https://artlist.io/referral/3497535/D...
